text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Dirt Derby, which 
crowns the champion of the dirt in the 
Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thrilled by how primed and ready the 
Umamusume of Ohi were, Inari One plunged 
into the stage of the festival.
